concepts.def: Troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere, thermosphere, exosphere; temperature inversion at stratopause.
O3 in stratosphere 15-35 km altitude; absorbs UV-B 280-315 nm; thinned by CFCs.
1987 international treaty phasing out CFCs and halons; ozone recovery on track by ~2070.
NOx and VOC + sunlight produce ground-level ozone and PAN; respiratory irritant.
Wet/dry fallout of H2SO4 and HNO3 from SO2 and NOx emissions; damages forests and lakes.
CO2, CH4, N2O, H2O, fluorinated gases absorb outgoing longwave; quantified by GWP.
